title: Juniper Security Advisories - 2026-07-01
description:
Merged 4 juniper security advisories published on 2026-07-01. Original advisory IDs: JSA110085, JSA110084, JSA110075, JSA110082

Titles:
- JSA110085 : 2026-07 Security Bulletin: Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved: EX Series, QFX Series, MX Series: A specific 'show l2-learning/ethernet-switching' command causes l2ald crash (CVE-2026-57025)
- JSA110084 : 2026-07 Security Bulletin: Junos OS: MX with SPC3, SRX Series: Repeated VPN negotiation failures will eventually cause iked to crash continuously (CVE-2026-57024)
- JSA110075 : 2026-07 Security Bulletin: Junos OS: MX Series: In a VC scenario a high rate of micro-BFD session flaps will cause an FPC crash (CVE-2026-33800)
- JSA110082 : 2026-07 Security Bulletin: Junos OS: MX Series with SPC3, SRX Series: Specific packet in response to a TCP connection establishment by the affected device can crash the PFE (CVE-2026-57022)
